interpretation: The current record is not a large broad sample. It combines narrow stress fixtures, which are useful for locating theorem obligations, with small selector-denominator scans, which have not yet produced broad active rows to stress.
next_non_circular_test: Predeclare a larger selector-denominator holdout, record scanned/selected/applicable/stressed counts separately, and only then run the expensive strict-closure stress pass on selected active rows without changing constants.
